text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — spike in 5xx/timeouts across edge region eu-west-1. Rolling 504s reported from gateway. Alert: gateway.prod.euw1 > 30m average 5xx rate 7x baseline. 

oncall-ana: grabbing pager. looking at graphs now, sending short triage. :coffee: 

sre-mike: I see a surge in backend timeouts originating from /v1/generate proxied requests. p95 latency jumped from 120ms to ~2.3s; backend svc-cacher timing out at 1.8s. logs sparse — request-id header missing on a lot of traces. 

eng-sophia: confirm — our ingress LB patch to reject slow clients hasn't propagated to eu-west; some older proxies are dropping X-Request-ID. that explains missing traces. we need a stopgap to attach a generated ID at the gateway so we can correlate. 

oncall-ana: customer-impact? any large customers affected? 

support-liz: support queue has ~12 new tickets referencing errors and timeouts in eu-west, a few saying app hung for users. Opening a short status note: "Degradation in eu-west, team investigating". 

pm-jared: pls add a short blurb for the status page — customers will want ETA. keep me posted on mitigation plan. 

eng-sophia: proposing quick probe + instrumentation hotpatch: 1) enable passthrough header insertion at gateway to add X-Temp-ReqId when missing 2) increase gateway debug sampling for 20m 3) route a small % of traffic to eu-central as fallback 4) temporary fast-fail config for svc-cacher from 1.8s -> 800ms to reduce queueing. 

sre-mike: agree. checklist: create hotpatch branch, config change, redeploy gateway container image (non-disruptive if we do a rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1). also enable ephemeral log-forwarding with higher verbosity to S3 for 1h. 

oncall-ana: i'll coordinate rollout. tagging @eng-sophia for the code changes and @infra-bot for the canary traffic reroute. 

eng-sophia: pushing quick patch now — small middleware snippet to apply if header missing: 

```
// gateway middleware (node)
if (!req.headers['x-request-id']) {
  req.headers['x-request-id'] = `temp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`
}
```

eng-sophia: config changes in k8s manifest: set ENV DEBUG_SAMPLING=0.75 for gateway for 20m window. will apply with `kubectl apply -f gateway-hotpatch.yaml` and then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway --namespace=prod-euw1`. 

infra-bot: scheduled canary reroute: 5% of eu-west-1 traffic -> eu-central-1 for 30m. Command: `routectl set-weight gateway-euw1 gateway-euc1 95:5 --expires 30m`. 

sre-mike: starting rolling restart (maxUnavailable=1). watch pods: 

```
kubectl -n prod-euw1 get pods -w -l app=gateway
```

oncall-ana: also enabling short-term log-shipping of gateway stdout to S3 prefix s3://redwood-internal/incident/1739501122 for deeper parsing. 

support-liz: posted updated status: "Mitigation in progress; we've routed a portion of traffic to a fallback region and are applying additional tracing to improve diagnosis. No wide data loss; some customers may see errors or increased latency." :white_check_mark: 

pm-jared: good. please capture an incident doc stub with customer list and timeline once we stabilize. 

eng-sophia: hotpatch applied, middleware added, debug sampling toggled. logs starting to surface with temp req ids. sending sample curl to validate: 

```
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.com" https://gateway.euw1.redwood.cloud/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
```

sre-mike: seeing a drop in backend queue depth and 5xx rate down from 7x -> 2x in the last 8 minutes. p95 latency trending back toward 350-600ms. still some noisy nodes — flagging node-7 for restart. 

oncall-ana: restarting node-7. 

infra-bot: node-7 cordoned and drained, then recreated. 

support-liz: customer-impact update: 2 customers on paid plans reported user-facing errors; no billing impact detected yet. queued for follow-up. 

eng-sophia: recommendation: keep the temp header insertion for one more hour to gather traces, then roll to more durable fix (ensure all proxy versions emit X-Request-ID). we'll also lower svc-cacher timeout back after traffic normalizes. 

oncall-ana: agreed. leaving pager until stabilization. tagging incident as "mitigated — monitoring" for now. :eyes: 

pm-jared: thumbs up. once we have the trace set, do an RCA draft focusing on missing request IDs and rollout propagation gaps. include remediation: backfill patch, stronger deploy gate for proxy versions, and SLA customer communication template. 

sre-mike: creating a short runbook note in #postmortems and linking logs S3 + sample traces. 

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> mitigated (partial). Pager remains assigned to oncall-ana for verification window (30m). :white_check_mark: 

oncall-ana: i'll keep monitoring for the next 30m and then hand off to next oncall. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
